title: MailboxRights: 3 distinct bit patterns hidden behind 7 constructors
description: inbox_defaults and newsgroup_defaults are bit-for-bit identical; drafts_defaults, trash_defaults, and archive_defaults are all identical; junk_defaults already delegates to trash_defaults but the other two duplicates do not. This means adding a new field (e.g. may_expunge) requires touching 5+ constructors instead of 1. A const-based or builder approach (e.g. three named const values plus a small set of flag overrides) would make field additions a single-site change and make the identity of the three real permission sets visible in code. Current design is a latent maintenance trap, not just style.
